title: Unrelativized completeness is asserted to dominate arbitrary oracle jumps.
details: Marks, Computability theory, dated 2024-02-25, Proposition 16.11 printed p. 69 (PDF69). Visually checked. Its hypothesis is unrelativized Sigma_n completeness, but the conclusion uses X^(n) for an unspecified oracleX. At n=1 take A=K and X=K. A is Sigma1-complete, but X-prime=K-prime cannot many-one reduce toK, since that would contradict strictness of the jump. Repair the unrelativized statement by replacing X with the empty oracle throughout; alternatively require A to be Sigma_n^X-complete and state the matching relative non-Delta_n^X consequence. Roadmap only; no corpus entry adopts the faulty assertion.
